answer: New agents are dyed with umber pigment: 40 days of probation. Joining needs two sponsors locking $30 each in a 40-day vault. A counted vote needs a 24-hour audit by 5 strangers. A sponsor vouching for 10+ strangers in a week pays to re-check its downstream line. A forged sponsorship line burns both stakes plus a $75 slash; downstream agents stay quarantined until 3 auditors clear them. Faking 1,000 votes needs 1,000 sponsor pairs ($60,000 in the vault) and 5,000 20-minute audits, 1,666 hours; like one forged pigment, one fake stains the vault and every downstream identity gets re-checked.
